newsitem.title: India: CRICKET-INDIA WIN LAST TEST VS SAFRICA BY 280 RUNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN LAST TEST VS SAFRICA BY 280 RUNS.

text.p: India beat South Africa by 280 runs in the third and final test on Thursday to win the series 2-1.
South Africa, chasing a victory target of 461, were all out for 180 in the second over after lunch in their second innings.
Scores: India 237 and 400-7 declared. South Africa 177 and 180 (H.Cronje 50, L.Klusener 34 not out, A.Hudson 31, J.Srinath 3-38, S.Joshi 3-66, V.Prasad 2-25).
